content.user_title: Configure n8n Nodes With Operation Context
content.value_statement: n8n nodes often change required fields by resource, operation, and visibility rules. This skill guides configuration, validation, and property discovery for reliable node setup.
actual_capabilities: Explains how resource and operation choices change required n8n fields.
Recommends get_node standard detail before full schema lookup.
Shows how to use search_properties to find hidden or conditional fields.
Provides examples for HTTP Request, Slack, database, IF, Switch, and Merge nodes.
Promotes iterative validation before workflow updates or deployment.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not call n8n APIs by itself.
Examples use placeholder endpoints and must be adapted to each workflow.
It does not include every node schema or version-specific behavior.
Credential setup and production deployment remain user responsibilities.

use_cases.title: Build a New HTTP Request Node
use_cases.description: Plan required fields, conditional body settings, authentication choices, and validation steps before deployment.

use_cases.title: Resolve n8n Validation Errors
use_cases.description: Trace missing fields to operation choices, toggles, and display options, then fix the configuration in order.

use_cases.title: Change Node Operations Safely
use_cases.description: Compare required fields before switching operations, such as changing a Slack message from post to update.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Node Configuration
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one n8n node.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure an n8n [node type] node for [goal]. Use standard discovery first and list the required fields.

prompt_templates.title: Find Conditional Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: I cannot see the [field] property on [node type]. Explain which resource, operation, or toggle controls its visibility.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Validation Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these n8n validation errors for [node type] and recommend configuration changes in the right order: [errors].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Node Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow configuration across related nodes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a validation-driven configuration plan for a workflow with [nodes]. Include discovery steps, dependency checks, and deployment checks.

output_examples.input: Configure an HTTP Request node for a POST request with a body.
output: Enable body sending when the method requires it.

output_examples.input: A Slack node changed from post message to update message.
output_examples.output: Recheck operation requirements. Update message needs a message identifier and text; channel is not the primary required field.

output_examples.input: Validation says a body field is missing.
output_examples.output: Check whether the method supports bodies and whether body sending is enabled. Search for body property dependencies if the field is hidden.

best_practices: Start with standard get_node detail before full schema lookup.
Validate after each meaningful configuration change.
Search for specific properties when a field is hidden or unclear.
anti_patterns: Opening full schema before checking standard detail.
Changing an operation without rechecking required fields.

faq.question: Does this skill execute workflow changes?
faq.answer: No. It provides configuration guidance and examples, but it does not call n8n APIs by itself.

faq.question: When should I use standard node detail?
faq.answer: Use standard detail first for most configuration work. It usually includes required fields and common options.

faq.question: When should I request full node detail?
faq.answer: Use full detail only when standard detail and property search do not answer the configuration question.

faq.question: Can it help with hidden fields?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how display options and dependency rules can hide or reveal fields.

faq.question: Does it include credential setup?
faq.answer: It can explain where credentials are required, but users must configure and protect credentials themselves.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is written for AI-assisted n8n configuration in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
